summary: AngloGold Ashanti plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying its Q3 and nine-month 2026 operating statistics, released 5 November 2026. Group gold production totaled 696koz for the quarter versus 768koz a year earlier, with nine-month output of 2,164koz against 2,292koz. Managed operations produced 605koz; Kibali, a 45%-attributable equity-accounted joint venture, contributed 91koz. Sukari (50%), Siguiri (85%) and Cerro Vanguardia (92.5%) are consolidated. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; Serra Grande's 1 December 2025 disposal is referenced only as a comparative note. Ordinary quarterly operating disclosure, not a special situation.
